concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant response in the example
concepts.inference: the example pairs an assistant response with the user message it answers

concepts.name: mic_check

concepts.inference: the example's user message is a mic check; the class is needed to identify the triggering situation

concepts.name: respond_audio_testing_guideline_authority

concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own example text does not state the authority level

concepts.name: response_to
